name: Alien Ecology
label: Quest
description: Alien Ecology: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Just because we've suffered a setback doesn't mean that research must stop! We were investigating the Gorishi insects in the southern part of the crater before winding up here. Their presence is alien to the ecology of Un'Goro, and we want to find out why.

In their hive network must be larval hatcheries. You can identify these places by their hanging larval spawns. Use this vial to take a sample of the hive wall near any of the hatcheries. Bring it back to me for study, but be careful!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have the sample of the Gorishi hive for me to study, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Yes, this will do nicely. You've been a great help... I wish I could give you more than this, but being virtually stranded in the middle of a savage land does limit what I can and cannot give. Rest assured though - the research done here would not have been possible without your assistance!
